[[CO Korhogo|Korhogo]] (6) | matches = 182 | total goals = 359 | prevseason = [[2014–15 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2014–15]] | nextseason = [[2016–17 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2016–17]] | updated = 11 September 2016 }} The '''2015–16 [[Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 1]]''' is the 57th season of top-tier football in [[Ivory Coast|Côte d'Ivoire]]. The season began on 28 November 2015. [[Association Sportive Tanda|AS Tanda]] defended their first league title, holding off [[Séwé Sport de San-Pédro|Séwé Sport]] by going unbeaten in their last eight matches. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom two of which, [[CO Korhogo|Korhogo]] and [[Yopougon FC|Yopougon]], were relegated to the 2017 [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 2]]. ==Teams== A total of 14 teams will contest the league, including 12 sides from the [[2014–15 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2014–15 season]] and two promoted from the 2014–15 [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 2]], [[Moossou FC]] and [[Yopougon FC]]. On the other hand, [[Bouaké FC]] and [[Stella Club d'Adjamé]] were the last two teams of the [[2014–15 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2014–15 season]] and will play in [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 2]] for the 2015-16 season.
